name: Eavesly
subtitle: Home upkeep and warranty vault
shortDescription: Tell Eavesly about your house and get a dated, sourced schedule for the year, plus a vault for every receipt, manual and warranty. Free, with optional ad-free.
longDescription:
Your house has a hundred small jobs and a dozen warranties, and nobody keeps track of either. Eavesly does.

Start with a minute of setup: the year the house was built, where it is, and what it has. Eavesly builds a seasonal schedule from that profile. A forced-air furnace gets a pre-winter service, a cold climate gets ice-dam and hose-bib reminders, a sump pump gets a regular test, a condo skips the gutters. Every job names the public source behind its interval (for example the U.S. Department of Energy, the EPA, NFPA and the Chimney Safety Institute) and carries a reminder to check your manufacturer's manual, which always wins.

### What You Can Do
- See Today at a glance: a home health score, what is overdue, what is next, and warranties about to end.
- Browse the Seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter, each with the jobs that fit your home, filterable by area.
- Say it in plain words: "Had Tri-County Heating service the furnace yesterday for $149". Eavesly finds the date, cost, contractor and the matching job on your device, logs it and reschedules the next one.
- Scan receipts, manuals and labels. On-device text recognition reads the total, date, model, serial and warranty length, files a PDF, and can add the item to your equipment register.
- Keep an equipment register with age against typical service life, warranty end dates and attached documents. Warranty alerts arrive 30 and 7 days before cover ends.
- Look ahead: a twelve-month cost outlook for routine upkeep and a monthly replacement reserve, using editable, indicative US cost ranges.
- Keep a service history and contractor notes: who did what, when, and what it cost.
- Export a home binder PDF with your profile, equipment, history, maintenance programme and scanned documents, ready for a buyer, an agent, an insurer or a new tenant.

### Private By Design
Your records stay on your iPhone or iPad. There is no account and no Eavesly server. Reading scans and sentences happens on the device.
